A standalone checker corroborated rational identities and finite-degree limits. No numerical experiment is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A single point mass naturally competes with m Fourier degrees of freedom. The complete tau~1/m crossover separates distinct m^-1 and m^-3/2 sharp sign-radius exponents with exact constants and a nontrivial Robin-type nonlinear critical curve. It also identifies local extremizer profiles for every phase, including the merging-zero endpoint. This is an all-degree structural transition, not a routine fixed-size coefficient computation; there is no broader arbitrary-measure universality claim.
